scope: Promote the learning-space terminal-state square budget and the crossed-subcube family of contraction-minimal nonlearning partial cubes from the active survey.

source_preservation.policy: The database owns the normalized counting law, construction theorem, parameterized obstruction-family definition, and concise proofs. The survey retains the full proofs, surrounding first-unresolved-dimension analysis, notation, and continuation families.
source_preservation.recoverability: The exact source hash and proposition locators preserve the complete scholarly context.
source_preservation.mutation: No source file in PartialCubes or another sibling repository was modified.

validation.website: Normalized 1327 generated HTML files; 12 tables and 2 graph views pass.
validation.graphs: 184 Hasse covers represent 230 stored inclusions; all 22 minor-atlas Ample-family nodes remain covered; all 114 classes have an audited position relative to Partial Cubes; 234 closure-map arrows render.

deferred: The crossed-subcube members are contraction-minimal nonmembers, not pc-minimal obstructions, because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
The full-cap, decorated, scaffold, staircase, and punctured-triangle continuation families remain queued for separate exact promotion.
